integrity_statement: The countable theorem is proved by a convexity and endpoint argument; finite computer checks are corroboration, not a substitute for proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to nonempty countable functional and inverse-functional directed acyclic graphs with finitely many components. Infinite-component models, arbitrary degrees, additional-vertex minimality and computable-order recovery are not asserted. The August 2026 source was available only in abstract, and equivalent older order-theoretic formulations remain a literature risk.
title: Exact finite-component criterion for countable immediate-successor graphs
